# Synthetic Impact contract fixture

`excess_wc.json` is intentionally invented, labelled test evidence. Its operational
requirement is a fixture axiom, not a benchmark extracted from Golden Manufacturing.
It qualifies arithmetic, history, scope and double-count mechanics only. No
production positive Impact contract is enabled by this fixture.

Tests resolve immutable typed copies from this fixture and explicit adversarial
variants. The production service has no default synthetic resolver. Synthetic
Impacts and totals permanently retain their separate evidence domain.

## Blind workbook

`Golden_Manufacturing_v2.49_Impact_Blind.xlsx` is the unchanged user-supplied blind
qualification source, SHA256
`eb3a5995a24d4fe06b6c1f27a070438c7e138b92b1da69ec62ef3cd4c0fc982b`.
It exercises the generic production receivables contract with explicit
`BLIND_QUALIFICATION` origin, never the synthetic resolver. Tests independently
derive the eligible invoice population without encoding a target amount.
This fixture is production-like evidence, not real customer evidence; its totals
cannot enter real-source aggregation. No private answer key is included.
